triage_formula: score = 100 x (0.35 people within 10 km [log scale] + 0.25 fire size [log scale, 300 km2 = full] + 0.2 wind blowing toward a town within 25 km x wind strength + 0.2 growth in the last hour), times detection confidence (1 pixel 0.67, 2 pixels 0.83, 3+ pixels 1)
notes: Area = fire pixels x GOES-18 pixel size (about 6.4 km2): approximate.
Growth compares the last 15 min with the same 15 min one hour earlier.
Small agricultural or industrial heat sources can appear as 1-pixel incidents.
